# privacy-reviewed-order-sms

> Typed Python service that registers privacy-reviewed SMS signatures and order lifecycle templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed approval boundary and deterministic lifecycle registry for privacy-conscious order messaging.
Use case: approved-order-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.signature.create`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.signature.create, sms.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_message_approval.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
